en-GB.name: Vinyl Vault
en-GB.summary: Ask about your record collection: its value, its most valuable record, and more.
en-GB.description: Answers questions about the record collection kept in Vinyl Value Vault: what it is worth, which record is the most valuable, what has gone up in value, and whether a record is in the collection.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask vinyl vault what my collection is worth
Alexa, ask vinyl vault how much are my records worth
